overall_reason: A long-lived awards-site template (DVS purple ring logo, Proxima Nova Soft and PT Serif, a vote sidebar and related-project thumbnails) built for this one job of showcasing an entry; nothing in it is the AI-default kit, and its faults are old-CMS data residue, not generated filler.

findings.evidence: "by , Jan Diehm, Amber Thomas (The Pudding)": an empty first author leaves a leading comma, while Credits lists 'Alvin Chang, Journalist-Engineer, The Pudding' who is missing from the byline.
findings.after: "by Alvin Chang, Jan Diehm, Amber Thomas (The Pudding)" (join only non-empty names)
findings.why: Template residue in the most visible credit line misattributes the work.

findings.evidence: An empty white card (about 725x80px) sits under the Credits/Award/Categories card with no content.
findings.after: Do not render the container when its field (likely comments or embed) is empty
findings.why: Failed T-DELETION: removing it loses nothing.

findings.evidence: Categories run together as plain links 'Longlist Gold Winners People, Language & Identity Outstanding Studio Shortlist' with no separators, so 'Gold Winners' reads as one phrase and the entry's actual standing (Gold? Shortlist?) is unclear.
findings.before: Longlist Gold Winners People, Language & Identity Outstanding Studio Shortlist
findings.after: Separate status from category: 'Gold, People, Language & Identity · Outstanding Studio' with longlist/shortlist history below
findings.why: The one fact a visitor wants (did it win?) is hidden in a tag soup.

strengths: The page leads with the entry's own artwork (The Pudding's purple silhouette title screen) at full content width; the design gets out of the way of the work.
Copy is specific and functional: 'If you think this project should win the People, Language & Identity category for the Information is Beautiful Awards 2024, cast your vote below'.
Related projects use their real thumbnails (On Upward Mobility, Gender and language, Creative Routines) rather than placeholder cards.
not_investigated: AddThis share script and analytics were blocked; share widgets absent from the render are not judged.
The embedded project itself (pudding.cool) is out of scope; only the showcase page is reviewed.
